title: merge --lane-lint fetches full history before the silent-undo step, or reports unknown, not FAIL
why: On a shallow cloud clone the silent-undo step reads 'history is shallow' UNKNOWN, and --strict turns it into FAIL. Seen on #1585 at 96f4fcc4f; `git fetch --unshallow origin` then passes (lane notes-fix-large-3, 23:51 CST Nov 7).
note: A false FAIL any cloud lane can hit. Related to done step ste-changed-shallow-clone (same shape in ste-changed). Held under the item 384 hold unless the coordinator calls it a queue fix. Title from the lane's suggestion. Filed 23:54 CST Nov 7.
